title: fairseq: A Fast, Extensible Toolkit for Sequence Modeling

numbers.sentence: During inference we build batches with a variable number of examples up to a user-specified number of tokens, similar to training. fairseq also supports inference in FP16 which increases decoding speed by 54% compared to FP32 with no loss in accuracy (Table ).
For En--De we replicate the setup of which relies on WMT'16 for training with 4.5M sentence pairs, we validate on newstest13 and test on newstest14.
We measure case-sensitive tokenized BLEU with multi-bleu and de-tokenized BLEU with SacreBLEU + numrefs.1+smooth.exp+test.wmt14/full+tok.13a+version.1.2.9 .
We measure case-sensitive tokenized BLEU with multi-bleu and de-tokenized BLEU with SacreBLEU + numrefs.1+smooth.exp+test.wmt14/full+tok.13a+version.1.2.9 .
All results use beam search with a beam width of 4 and length penalty of 0.6, following . fairseq results are summarized in Table .
The second model has 24 blocks, inner dimension 8K and embedding dimension 1.5K; results on the One Billion Word benchmark are in Table .
We evaluate on the full-text version with no entity anonymization ; we truncate articles to 400 tokens .
